intro: Across 32 articles published between 2026-04-13 and 2026-09-16, ZCyberNews tracked privilege-escalation activity spanning technology, enterprise, government, healthcare, and education sectors, with reporting reaching Global, Brazil, France, Germany, and India. Coverage centered on five high-severity flaws: CVE-2026-8950, CVE-2026-8956, and CVE-2026-8957, each rated CVSS 9.8, alongside CVE-2026-34659 and CVE-2026-34660 at CVSS 9.6. Chaotic Eclipse and Lazarus Group featured among the threat actors examined. The severity mix comprised 23 high, 5 critical, and 3 medium items.
